en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town with dense rows of 3–4 story masonry houses and steep tiled roofs. In the middle and background rise two large baroque or neo‑baroque church towers dominating the skyline. Smokestacks and factory buildings suggest early industrialization, while bare trees indicate either late autumn or early spring. The town is surrounded by gently rolling, cultivated hills. The image has the aspect and framing of an old photographic postcard, but no visible caption or border text.
